info.scriptSrcText: global gProControlson exitFrame me  go(the frame)endon mouseUp  case the rollover of    10:      gProControls = 0      go("menuScreen")      puppetSound(2, member(12, "Sfx"))    11:      gProControls = 1      go("menuScreen")      puppetSound(2, member(12, "Sfx"))  end caseend
info.name: ControlScreenScript
